entity: Dormant ('zombie') campaign committees of former candidates, 2024-cycle spending and share to candidates, parties and PACs
what_we_add: $8,569,194.71 out from 189 committees in the 2024 cycle (median $1,794.61); 19.4% to candidates, parties and PACs (23.5% with loan repayments), not 2.1%
why: Tampa Bay Times, Campaign Legal Center and NOTUS cover zombie campaigns and leftover cash flowing to parties, colleagues and PACs. None covers the 2024 cycle or this set of committees; their windows and totals are different.
